title: Cartwise+ Membership Pause Extension for Regular Grocery Spending
content:
Regular shoppers get a spending extension added to the Cartwise+ Membership pause allowance, read from the item charges on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders.

**Scale.** Item charges on the member's orders in the last three months totalling at least 200.00 add 7 days; at least 100.00 and less than 200.00 add 3 days; less add 0 days.

| Item charges on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders in the last three months (USD) | Days added |
|---|---|
| 200.00 or more | 7 |
| 100.00 to 199.99 | 3 |
| below 100.00 | 0 |

## What is totalled

The item-charge entries of the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders dated in the last three months, by amount. The window is counted in whole months ending today: with today 18 August, charges dated 19 May through 18 August count, and one dated 18 May does not.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

| Item charges in the window | Days added |
|---|---|
| 200.00 | 7 |
| 199.99 | 3 |
| 100.00 | 3 |
| 99.99 | 0 |
